# 1,000.00 USD of income paid into A at −500.00, giving A's owed cost basis,
# and valued at 600.00 — less than the 675.00 the 500.00 it repays cost.
#
# What is left for the 500.00 it brings in would be −75.00, a cost below
# nothing, so it is refused, and the refusal gives the 1,375.00 the split is
# worth.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
